title: Raynaud prolongation of a symmetrized generic ample module
statement: Let $S$ be a normal integral locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-integral-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], where normal means that every local ring is an integrally closed domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Let $p:G\to S$ be a smooth separated commutative group scheme of finite presentation [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], with identity $e$. The addition, inverse and identity are $S$-morphisms satisfying the commutative group identities; separated means that the diagonal is a closed immersion. Assume every geometric fibre is semiabelian: after an algebraically closed residue-field extension $k$, it fits into an exact sequence of fppf sheaves $1\to\mathbf G_{m,k}^r\to G_k\to A_k\to1$, where $r\geq0$, $\mathbf G_{m,k}=\operatorname{Spec}k[t,t^{-1}]$, and $A_k$ is a proper smooth geometrically connected $k$-group scheme. Write $\eta$ for the generic point of $S$, $K=\kappa(\eta)$ for its residue field, and $G_\eta=G\times_S\operatorname{Spec}K$. Let $L$ be an ample invertible module on $G_\eta$ [def-sc-invertible-module, def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Put $\Sigma(L)=L\otimes[-1]^*L$, where tensor product is the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and pullback is tensor inverse image [def-pc-module-pullback]. There is an affine open covering $S=\bigcup_j W_j$ such that for each nonempty $W_j$ there are an integer $a_j\geq1$, an invertible module $Q_j$ on $G_{W_j}$, and an isomorphism $(Q_j)_\eta\simeq\Sigma(L)^{\otimes a_j}$. Moreover $Q_j$ is relatively ample: its restriction above every affine open of $W_j$ is ample. No extension of $L$ itself, and no properness of $G_\eta$, is assumed.

source.place: XI Theorem 1.13, generic ample symmetrization form used in Moret-Bailly II 3.3.3, printed p.53, opening paragraph. Local original WANTED; agent-formulated power version of the generic polarization input, not a claim of a verbatim transcription.

proof.text: For each $s\in S$, apply [lem-sfb-semiabelian-generic-picard-class-lifting] to the class $\alpha=[L]$ modulo geometric algebraic equivalence. Obtain an affine neighbourhood $W_s$ of $s$, an integer $n_s\geq1$ and a line $M_s$ on $G_{W_s}$ such that $T_s=(M_s)_\eta\otimes(L^{\otimes n_s})^\vee$ is geometrically algebraically trivial. The chosen $W_s$ cover $S$ and are nonempty; since $S$ is integral each contains $\eta$. The hypotheses on the restricted group are exactly those in the cited statement. This step lifts a class only, not the line $L$.

source.place: XI 1.13; agent assembly of class lifting, inversion cancellation, and XI 1.16 positivity; compare Moret-Bailly II 3.3.3.

proof.text: Fix $s$ and abbreviate $W=W_s$, $n=n_s$, $M=M_s$, $T=T_s$. By [lem-sc-ample-positive-tensor-power], $L^{\otimes n}$ is ample, since $n\geq1$. Clause (ii) of [lem-sfb-semiabelian-algebraic-equivalence-norm] applied on the semiabelian $K$-group $G_\eta$ gives that $M_\eta\simeq L^{\otimes n}\otimes T$ is ample. The relation defining $T$ gives this isomorphism by tensor evaluation. This uses the semiabelian field statement, not the proper-abelian special case.

source.place: XI 1.13; agent assembly of class lifting, inversion cancellation, and XI 1.16 positivity; compare Moret-Bailly II 3.3.3.

proof.text: Set $Q=M\otimes\iota^*M$ on $G_W$, where $\iota=[-1]$. It is invertible by [lem-weil-pbc-invertible-pullback-tensor]. Inversion is an $S$-morphism, so $\iota j=j\iota_\eta$ for the generic-fibre map $j:G_\eta\to G_W$. Tensor-pullback compatibility and composition from the same node, followed by reordering tensor factors, therefore give $Q_\eta\simeq(L^{\otimes n}\otimes\iota_\eta^*L^{\otimes n})\otimes(T\otimes\iota_\eta^*T)$. Clause (i) of [lem-sfb-semiabelian-algebraic-equivalence-norm] identifies the last parenthesis with $\mathcal O_{G_\eta}$. Distribute pullback over the $n$ factors and interleave them to obtain $Q_\eta\simeq(L\otimes\iota_\eta^*L)^{\otimes n}=\Sigma(L)^{\otimes n}$. Thus the generic discrepancy has disappeared, even though $M_\eta$ need not be isomorphic to $L^{\otimes n}$.

source.place: XI 1.13; agent assembly of class lifting, inversion cancellation, and XI 1.16 positivity; compare Moret-Bailly II 3.3.3.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-semiabelian-supplied-norm-ampleness] to $G_W\to W$ and the supplied line $M$. The base is normal integral and locally Noetherian, the group is smooth separated commutative of finite presentation with semiabelian geometric fibres, and step 2 supplied ampleness of $M_\eta$. It follows that $Q=M\otimes\iota^*M$ is relatively ample over $W$, in the asserted sense over every affine open of $W$. For every $s$ take $W_j=W_s$, $Q_j=Q$ and $a_j=n_s\geq1$, with the isomorphism from step 3. These data prove all the clauses, without assuming properness of the generic fibre.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q35-e59e47e7a (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, all 3 new nodes and every cited statement in full. Raynaud LNM119 and Moret-Bailly are not in literature/; they are recorded as WANTED, proof_origin is agent, and nothing cites SGA. Compared with live, the statement is unchanged: the item is still unsplit there, with no repair note and no other group's split. Step 1 (class lifting): the hypotheses match verbatim, and [M_eta]=n[L] modulo the subgroup Pic0_geom means T is geometrically algebraically trivial. Step 2: L^n is ample by the positive-power node, and clause (ii) of the norm node applies on G_eta over K, which is semiabelian. Step 3: inversion is an S-morphism, so pullback-tensor (1),(2) gives Q_eta≅(L^n⊗ι*L^n)⊗(T⊗ι*T); clause (i) over K gives Σ(L)^n. Step 4: supplied-norm ampleness applies on the affine W with M_eta ample, giving relative ampleness over every affine open of W, as the item requires. Truth checks on the new nodes: (i) holds over k via primitivity, since the H1(Gal,U) kernel is detected on the axes; (ii) holds via translation when N is nondegenerate and via a character-section argument when it is degenerate; both tested on a non-split torus, G_m×E and E minus the zero section of a non-torsion P. Class lifting holds in the abelian case through the extension of φ_L. In general it follows from the item plus ample-difference, so it is consistent, strictly weaker than the item, and not a D1 restatement. Supplied-norm ampleness is Raynaud's XI 1.13 positivity: it generalizes regular-group and normal-cubical generic ampleness without duplicating them, and I tested it on constant and non-split families over a DVR. B1-B3 and B7 are fine; proof_deps is the union of the uses. I accept the tool_uses lem-sc-ample-positive-tensor-power and lem-weil-pbc-invertible-pullback-tensor. There is no cycle now.
